title: loop-auth polish: freeze exported constants, tailor missing-bundle-dir error, fix fixture twin
description: LOW follow-ups from the TASK-075 review (2026-07-02). (2) The absent-bundle error path where the pointer names a session whose bundle dir is missing surfaces a raw ENOENT from readBundleSession - tailor to a clear typed message and lock with a spec. acceptance_criteria: Object.freeze applied to UNATTENDED_PRESET and LOOP_AUTH_SWITCHES; a spec proves mutation attempts do not alter later grants.

operating-mode e2e fixture uses a schema-valid session id; suite green.
